question: It seems Ros-chi has been working in secret for 400 years, but has he participated in anything like the Demihuman Uprising, or the Evil Dragon Subjugation, and gained any recognition as a hero? Or has he deliberately not, to allow Subaru to resolve things? (The Three Great Mabeasts, and such)
answer: Ros-chi has been working desperately to follow the writings of the ‘Book of Wisdom’, so he basically doesn’t do anything that isn’t written. But, in order to bring to pass anything that is written, he’s always alert for ways to improve his personal power, and improve his personal standing.
